answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits to an evaluation point on the epoch polynomial, while Semaphore membership and RLN nullifiers bind messages to one authorized identity. A repeated rate-limited message yields two shares of the same Shamir secret, allowing interpolation to recover the private key and prove equivocation; the contract then slashes collateral immediately. Marble, fable, and comet are merely distinct inputs, not extra identities.
